column1: # linux-baseline-ports.csv — Baseline port profile for Linux/macOS hosts.
# LINUX_BASELINE_PORTS) and loaded by check_security_posture to classify
# listening ports beyond the current posture snapshot/diff. Edit this file
# to match your fleet's real baseline — the shipped defaults are a starting
# point covering common services and well-known risky ports
# completeness guarantee for every distro or workload.
#   severity: "baseline"  — expected on every host of this OS type
#                            flagged even if it appears in the report.
#             "info"/"warning"/"critical" — a known port that is always
#                            flagged at this severity when found listening
#                            regardless of baseline status. The agent still
#                            weighs the host's stated system purpose before
#                            treating a flagged port as an incident.
# Any listening port matching no row at all is reported as an unclassified

column4: RDP -- unusual on a Linux host
